title: FE↔PO-001: UX Requirements + Dashboard Feature Requests
description: Product Owner/TPM provides user-facing requirements, field-operator workflow context, and acceptance criteria for dashboard/UI features; Frontend provides UX prototypes, implementation feasibility feedback, sprint progress, and design-constraint feedback. Grounded in PRODUCT_OWNER_TECHNICAL_PROJECT_MANAGER_SKILL §6.9 and FRONTEND_DASHBOARD_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.3.

x-macp.tier_rationale: Dashboard feature intake and UX feasibility are agent-autonomous sprint-level coordination.
x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER (sprint-level sync; dedicated review session for any user-facing release)
confirm_conditions: each dashboard_feature_request carries acceptance_criteria and operator workflow context
reject_conditions: a user-facing feature committed without acceptance criteria
PO requirement dictating implementation detail FE owns (overreach)
counter_conditions: acceptance criteria not verifiable in the UI — request a measurable definition
operator workflow underspecified for an edge case — request field-operator validation
